skill_name: Summarize the following article into 5-6 sentences
workflow: Sodium is an essential electrolyte for the body’s overall health. It helps to regulate hormones, maintain fluid and acid balance, as well as transmits nerve impulses, helps muscles and maintains blood pressure. Too little sodium, known as hyponatremia, can be life-threatening, while an imbalance in sodium-potassium levels can lead to serious health issues. Recent research shows that dietary sodium is an important factor in staying healthy, and so it is important to ensure our diets are balanced
